name: Runemaster Unbound Energy grants 3/6% critical strike chance and 4/8 expertise (#1193)
contract: Unbound Energy 705570 (rank 1) and 707877 (rank 2), CharacterAdvancement 6474, SpellFamilyName 38, read
'Increases your critical strike chance by $s1% and your expertise by $s2.' Both are passive auras on the caster:
effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_EXPERTISE (240), EquippedItemClass -1, with
EffectBasePoints 2 / 3 (rank 1: +3%, +4) and 5 / 7 (rank 2: +6%, +8) plus DieSides 1. Both aura types have
native handlers: AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct adds the amount to the melee, ranged and spell critical
strike fields and Player::UpdateExpertise adds item-neutral expertise auras to PLAYER_EXPERTISE. No script is
needed; the report's premise (no handler for the ids) is wrong. A fresh character's crit fields are only
populated once a crit aura recomputes them, so the baselines are taken after a priming learn and unlearn of
rank 1. Expected: melee and Fire spell critical strike chance +3 and expertise +4 with rank 1, back to the
baseline after unlearning it, and +6 / +8 with rank 2.
